collection.name: Game Servers
collection.description: Multiplayer dedicated game servers powered by SteamCMD and native game engines
collection.author: Midnight Team

shard.name: FiveM (txAdmin)
shard.description: Official GTA V FiveM multiplayer dedicated server (FXServer) with integrated txAdmin web management panel, automated recipe setup (QBCore, ESX, CFX Default), live console, player manager, and Discord bot integration.
shard.author: CitizenFX, Tabarra & Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# FiveM (txAdmin) Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apt update && apt install -y curl xz-utils tar ca-certificates

cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${FIVEM_VERSION}" ] || [ "${FIVEM_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    echo "Resolving latest FiveM / FXServer recommended artifacts..."
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -s https://runtime.fivem.net/artifacts/fivem/build_proot_linux/master/ | grep -Eo 'https://runtime.fivem.net/artifacts/fivem/build_proot_linux/master/[0-9]+-[a-f0-9]+/fx.tar.xz' | head -n 1)
    if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ]; then
        DOWNLOAD_URL="https://runtime.fivem.net/artifacts/fivem/build_proot_linux/master/fx.tar.xz"
    fi
else
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://runtime.fivem.net/artifacts/fivem/build_proot_linux/master/${FIVEM_VERSION}/fx.tar.xz"
fi

echo "Downloading FXServer from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}..."
curl -sSL -o fx.tar.xz "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

echo "Extracting FXServer files..."
tar -xJf fx.tar.xz
rm -f fx.tar.xz

chmod +x run.sh
if [ -f "alpine/opt/cfx-server/FXServer" ]; then
    chmod +x alpine/opt/cfx-server/FXServer
fi

echo "FiveM (txAdmin) installation completed successfully!"
